test(scoring): cover longevity rule without previous-year data

The existing test only exercises the year-over-year branch of rule 2.14.
Add a fixture with previousYearTotalContributions set to null so the
no-yoy branch (3 factors with 40/30/30 weights) is also regression-tested.

test(scoring): pin the observed score value, not just the factor bound

The regression test now asserts the concrete symptom (both scores read a flat
100 upstream for a month-old account) and that each score still equals the sum
of its factors, instead of only checking earned <= max.

fix(scoring): scale giving-back and longevity factors by their weights

saturatingScore() and activeRatio * 100 already return a 0-100 value, so a
factor worth 35 points has to be multiplied by 0.35, not by 35. Rules 2.13 and
2.14 multiplied by the factor maximum instead, inflating every factor 100x.
finishScore() then clamped the total, so both scores read a flat 100 for almost
any input and the "why this score" tooltip printed earned values far above the
stated maximum (269/35, 797/22).

Rule 2.2 and the year-over-year factor of 2.14 itself already use the 0.xx form.

Merge pull request #31 from 0xarchit/feat/opennext-migration

feat: migrate from @cloudflare/next-on-pages to OpenNext on Workers

feat: migrate from @cloudflare/next-on-pages to OpenNext on Workers

Pages builds fail because @cloudflare/next-on-pages v1 cannot read Next 16's
build output. Next 16 emits .func server entries for routes that used to be
pure static (/, /settings, /_not-found, /_global-error), and next-on-pages'
classifier only accepts a .func when it is ISR-prerendered, api-prerendered,
or runtime "edge" -- so it aborts with "routes were not configured to run with
the Edge Runtime". The adapter is deprecated upstream in favour of OpenNext.

Adapter:
- replace @cloudflare/next-on-pages with @opennextjs/cloudflare
- add wrangler.jsonc (Workers; nodejs_compat; DB D1 + ASSETS/IMAGES bindings)
- add open-next.config.ts (no incremental cache: the app has no ISR)
- initOpenNextCloudflareForDev() in next.config.ts for local dev
- .dev.vars, public/_headers, .gitignore entries, preview/deploy/upload/
  cf-typegen scripts

Edge runtime removal:
OpenNext does not support `export const runtime = "edge"`, so it is removed
from all 18 routes, which now run on the Node.js runtime. This also drops the
edge-runtime warnings from @upstash/redis and jose.

Losing edge runtime re-enabled GET-route static optimisation on routes Next
previously skipped, surfacing three latent bugs:
- /analytics ran its Redis read during prerender; Next's DYNAMIC_SERVER_USAGE
  control-flow error was caught and logged as a cache failure (and fired
  Telegram alerts). Marked force-dynamic.
- both SSE routes buffered the whole body instead of streaming. Marked
  force-dynamic as streaming GET handlers.
- the analysis UI could sit on "Initializing" forever: Strict Mode remounts
  the component, the unmount closes the EventSource, and the useRef guard made
  the remount skip fetchData(), so the stream was never reopened.

Also: getRequestContext -> getCloudflareContext in star-gate and the star
webhook, and the lint script now ignores .open-next/.wrangler build output.

Verified: opennextjs-cloudflare build exit 0, tsc clean, 37/37 tests, and the
worker boots on workerd with every binding resolved.

shared.ts:

- sortedStats(): sort once, return {median,p25,p75,p90} for multi-percentile callers
- standardDeviation: Welford single-pass — eliminates temp array + double mean() call

baseline.ts:
- rule1_16: 4 independent sort+percentile calls → sortedStats() (single sort)
- rule1_17: cache days array + avgDays; avoid double mean() in description string

- AUTHENTICITY_SIGNAL_IDS: module-level Set — O(1) .has() vs O(k) .includes() per signal

charts.ts:
- histogram(): O(n×b) filter-per-bucket → O(n log b) binary search (used in 4.17/4.18/4.19)
- streakSegments(): O(n²) indexOf() in loop → O(n) index variable i with days[i-1]
- cachedLanguageTotals(): WeakMap memoizes languageTotals; rules 4.5 + 4.31 share one pass

- rule4_29: single for-of + push replaces .filter().map().sort() triple pass

- allCommits: WeakMap memoize — 4 callers (3.4, 3.5, 3.7, 3.35) share one flatMap

- rule3_4: mutable .push() replaces spread-append [...arr, item] — O(1) vs O(n) per insert
- rule3_10/3.19: reduce(sum+arr.length) replaces .flat() just to count — no alloc
- rule3_14: single for-of with index arithmetic — no slice().concat() intermediates
